messages:
COOLTRAINER~PARKER sent out
Oranguru and Farigiraf!

Houndoom’s Houndoominite is reacting
to BRENDAN’s Me

Houndoom has Mega Evolved
into Mega Houndoom!

The opposing Oranguru twisted
the dimensions!

The opposing Farigiraf followed the
opposing Orangur

The opposing Farigiraf followed the
opposing Orangur

Incineroar knocked off the opposing
Farigiraf’s Assa

It doesn’t affect the
opposing Oranguru…

It’s super effective on Incineroar
and Aegislash!

The opposing Lickilicky followed the
opposing Orangu

It doesn’t affect the
opposing Oranguru…
Incineroar was damaged by the recoil!

The twisted dimensions
returned to normal!

Togekiss is paralyzed, so it
may be unable to move!

The opposing Spinda was damaged
by the recoil!

The opposing Lickilicky flinched
and couldn’t move!

Togekiss couldn’t move because
it’s paralyzed!

The opposing Spinda was damaged
by the recoil!

You have no more Pokémon
that can fight!
You were overwhelmed by your defeat!
